title: A Remote Approach to Cashew Orchard Detection: Leveraging Active Learning with Satellite Imagery in Guinea-Bissau
abstract: arXiv:2608.11996v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cashew production is a widespread economic activity in Guinea-Bissau, as well as other countries in West Africa. However, unregulated cashew production can be directly associated with increasing regionwide deforestation rates, biodiversity losses, and a fragile economic structure. There is no nationwide database for listing or georeferencing cashew orchards, so there is a clear need to remotely map their locations. In recent years, multiple methods for detecting orchards have been developed, though they have only been applied on a regional level. This work expands regional analyses to a nationwide scale. It develops a scalable and cost-effective remote approach, based on Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, using Machine Learning techniques to detect cashew orchards automatically. translated_title: 一种远程腰果园检测方法：利用主动学习与卫星影像在几内亚比绍的应用
translated_abstract: 摘要：腰果生产是几内亚比绍以及西非其他国家广泛的经济活动。然而，无监管的腰果生产可能直接与区域森林砍伐率上升、生物多样性丧失和脆弱的经济结构相关。目前没有全国性数据库来列出或地理参照腰果园，因此明确需要远程绘制其位置。近年来，已开发出多种检测果园的方法，但仅在区域层面应用。本研究将区域分析扩展到全国范围。它开发了一种可扩展且成本效益高的远程方法，基于Sentinel-2卫星影像，利用机器学习技术自动检测腰果园。采用基于边距的主动学习技术来优化训练集，就点数量和信息性而言，从而实现了约...
tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于卫星影像和主动学习的可扩展远程方法，首次将腰果园检测从区域扩展到全国范围，实现了成本效益高的自动检测。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a scalable and cost-effective remote approach based on satellite imagery and active learning, extending cashew orchard detection from regional to nationwide scale for the first time.
